text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (November 20, 2023) for 200 Jameson Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (November 20, 2023) for 200 Jameson Avenue, Folder Number: 23 225921 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to November 20, 2024.
